posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Please cover the entire W1-W9 syllabus of the course to be better prepared, this level of micro-compartmentalization will not help you prepare at all. Expect questions from entire syllabus, broadly in same pattern as NPPE.

Repeatedly asking about exact details of the pattern will not help you score more in the exam, it might have the opposite effect of making you lose overarching context of how different tools/concept interplay with each other, which is usually required to solve these questions confidently and in a reasonable amount of time.
